text: When a change is staged for admin approval and admin approval is granted, the system shall delete the record.
The workflow shall activate upon senior-admin approval after the configuration details are validated and the setup is staged for senior-admin approval.
Upon admin approval of a validated and staged approval-start request, the system shall delete the asset record identified by the asset ID in that request.
The system shall stage a validated deletion request for admin approval and, upon admin approval, update the corresponding asset record status to 'Modified'.
Upon senior-admin approval, the system shall activate the workflow and store the workflow with status “Configured.”
When a submitted asset request is approved or rejected, the system shall send a user notification that communicates the request decision.
When a workflow is activated, the system shall ensure that the stored workflow has status 'Configured'.
The system shall update the request status upon admin approval to reflect the approval decision.
When users check the status of asset or user operations, the system shall return approval status details including the operation status (pending, in progress, approved, or rejected).
When an administrator approves or rejects an asset request, the system shall notify users of the decision.
When a validated approval-start request is staged for admin review and the operation is executed upon approval, the system shall update the operation status to reflect the executed operation.
The Transfer Asset workflow shall require a submitted Transfer form containing the asset ID and new recipient before processing a transfer request.
Upon admin approval, the requested registration, usage, transfer, or return operation shall be executed.
When staged changes are approved, the system shall update the user record and set its status to 'Modified'.
The system shall update the asset status to “Returned” only after the return request has been validated, staged for approval, and approval is granted.
The requirement shall specify the conditions for admin approval of a request staged for admin review and the status update that occurs after admin approval.
The system shall generate the export file only after the export request has been successfully validated.
Upon successful 'Export Asset Data', the system shall generate a 'Downloadable data file' and make it available for download.

After modification data is validated, the system shall stage the change for admin approval, and upon admin approval, the system shall execute the associated registration, usage, transfer, or return operation.
The system shall ensure that a valid approval-start request, after validation, staging for admin review, and admin approval, updates ownership and results in the asset status 'Transferred'.
Decide and document whether 'Admin' is an alias of 'Administrators' or a distinct actor in the FR-01 asset registration review workflow.
Document whether 'Administrator' is the singular alias of 'Administrators' or a distinct role in the FR-01 review step.
Clarify whether 'User' is an alias for 'Users' or a distinct actor in the FR-01 asset registration process.
Decide whether FR-01 must document an 'Approved' review outcome or explicitly exclude it from the registration workflow.
Determine whether FR-01 should define a 'Rejected' outcome and any follow-up action for rejected registrations, or state that rejection is out of scope.
Define the scope and atomicity of the 'Register Asset' operation relative to validation, storage, status transition, and notification.
Specify whether 'Validate Format and Data' is the operation that performs FR-01 validation and whether it must complete before asset storage.
Clarify whether 'Validate Request' is the FR-01 validation operation, a separate check, or out of scope for asset registration.
The system must define what happens to the staged asset modification and asset status when Admin rejects it.
The system must keep the active asset record unchanged and record the modification as pending until Admin approval.
The system must set the asset record status to Modified only upon Admin approval and must not apply Modified status otherwise.
The system must block staging of invalid modification data and provide validation feedback to the user.
The system must define the editable asset fields for modification, at minimum name, type, quantity, and purchase date, and accept a submit action.
Define matching rules for asset detail search by name, type, and ID.
Specify how search criteria are combined and whether any criterion is mandatory for asset detail queries.
Define the required output fields and schema for detailed asset information.
If Admin roles are in scope, document their query permissions and visibility limits for asset details.
Resolve whether User and Users refer to the same actor for asset detail query authorization.
If approval statuses are in scope, define whether they are returned or filterable in asset detail queries.
The system must route staged transfer requests to a designated Admin approver and record the approval decision.
The system must record the requesting User and notify them when the transfer is approved or rejected.
The system must validate the asset ID and new recipient in the transfer form before staging the request for approval.
The system must hold a transfer request in a pending approval state and allow an Admin to approve or reject it.
The system must update the asset owner information and set status to Transferred upon admin approval.
The system must set the asset status to Transferred only after ownership update succeeds.
The system should capture the initiating user on each asset return request and validate that the user is authorized to return the asset.
The system should define which role (e.g., Admin) is authorized to approve staged asset return requests.
The system should validate that the asset exists and is in a returnable state before staging the return request.
The system should only update asset status to Returned after a positive approval event and leave status unchanged on rejection.
The system should record the return request as Approved when an approver grants approval, and use that record to trigger the asset status update.
The system should allow the initiating user to cancel a staged return request before approval is decided.
The system shall validate a deletion request against defined asset eligibility and requester authorization rules before staging it for approval.
The system shall treat only assets in the obsolete state as eligible for a deletion request.
The system shall record each deletion request with at least the asset ID and the requesting user identity for validation and approval.
The system shall create a pending approval record for each validated deletion request and make it available to an admin for decision.
The system shall delete the asset record only after an authorized admin approves the staged deletion request.
The system shall mark an approved asset deletion with the status 'Deleted' and define whether the underlying record is physically removed or retained as deleted.
Only an authorized Admin shall be permitted to approve or reject a staged deletion request.
The system shall allow Users to submit deletion requests for obsolete assets and shall define any post-submission visibility for those requests.
The user-account creation operation may require duplicate-account or idempotency handling before storage.
The new-user form validation operation may enforce field-specific constraints for username, password, email, phone, and department before storage.
Activation-email dispatch may be a conditional post-storage operation with defined retry or skip conditions.
Administrator authorization may be explicitly checked before user creation.
The User element may require a documented relationship to the new-user record and its Activated state.
The system must define and enforce the Admin approval/rejection decision on staged profile changes before updating the user record.
The system must define whether a User can withdraw a staged profile-edit request before Admin action.
The system must validate profile-edit inputs and report field-specific errors before staging changes.
The system must apply staged changes only after Admin approval and must define behavior for rejection or staging conflicts.
The system must restrict profile editing to the authenticated User's own record.
The system must define whether a Modified profile can be edited again or must transition through another status.
The User actor should be traceable to the query user details workflow, but no new integration should be assumed solely from isolation.
The Query User Details operation should be documented as a search/query operation; no create/update/delete obligations should be inferred from FR-09 alone.
The Query User Details operation should include a documented access-control requirement because its output includes permission level.
The system shall identify the user account targeted by a deletion request by its user ID.
The system shall restrict approval of staged deletion requests to an authorized senior-admin role.
The system shall prevent deletion of the user record until senior-admin approval is recorded.
The system shall validate that the deletion request contains a valid, existing user ID and is permitted for deletion before staging it.
The system shall persist the validated deletion request in a pending senior-admin approval state and expose it for approval.
The system shall execute the approved deletion according to a documented deletion mode and record an audit entry.
The workflow definition operation must capture node order, approvers, and conditions.
The system must validate workflow configuration details before staging for approval.
Staged workflow configurations must remain pending senior-admin approval until approved or withdrawn.
Workflow activation must occur only after senior-admin approval.
Senior Admin approval must be documented as the authorization event for activating staged workflows.
Every staged workflow configuration must require senior-admin approval before activation.
If an operation type requires senior-admin approval, the system must withhold execution until that approval condition is satisfied.
If admin review rejects an approval-start request, the system must record the request as Rejected and not execute the operation.
If an approval-start request is staged for admin review, the system must reflect the operation status as Pending until approval or rejection.
If an approval-start request is approved and executed, the system must set the operation status to Approved.
If validation is a distinct operation, the system must invoke Validate Request before staging an approval-start request for admin review.
If format/data validation is required, the system must validate the asset ID and operation type before staging the request for admin review.
If an approved operation modifies an asset, the system must invoke Asset change to apply and record the modification.
If registration approval results in a new user account, the system must invoke Send Activation Email upon approval execution.
The system shall provide a query operation that accepts asset ID, operation type, and user ID and returns the corresponding approval status.
The system shall return approval status details containing at least the queried operation identifier and its current status.
The system shall report pending as a distinct approval status for asset or user operations.
The system shall report in progress as a distinct approval status for asset or user operations.
The system shall report approved as a distinct approval status for asset or user operations.
The system shall report rejected as a distinct approval status for asset or user operations.
The system must validate proposed workflow changes before staging them for senior-admin approval.
The system must stage validated workflow changes for senior-admin approval before applying them.
A senior admin must be able to approve staged workflow changes, and the system must record the approval decision.
Upon senior-admin approval, the system must update the workflow with the approved changes.
An approved and updated workflow must have the status 'Modified'.
The system must identify senior admins who are authorized to approve staged workflow changes.
The system must assign a pending status to staged workflow changes awaiting senior-admin approval.
The system must handle rejection of staged workflow changes and record the decision.
Administrators must be able to modify existing workflows through a workflow-edit form.
Only authorized administrators may modify existing workflows.
The system shall validate report parameters before generating a report.
The system shall store generated report data after successful report generation.
The system shall produce stored report data and a generated file when generating a report.
The system shall allow a user to initiate report generation by providing report parameters.
The system must document how the Prepare File operation is invoked and how it produces the downloadable report file within the export workflow.
The system must document how the Provide Download Link operation connects to the downloadable report file output.
The system must document how Validate Request uses the selected report and export format to authorize the export.
Export Report must be supported by the operations Validate Request, Prepare File, and Provide Download Link as documented in the export workflow.
The system must create an export log as part of the export operation and make it available after the export completes.
The system must document the operation that makes the report file downloadable after export preparation.
The system must document how a report becomes selected for export, including capture of export format.
The system should associate each asset-data import with the uploading User for audit and traceability, if user identity is available.
The system should define file-format and row-data validation rules and specify how validation errors are reported per row or per file.
The system should define row-level parse error handling, including whether parsing continues for subsequent rows and how parse failures appear in the error report.
The system should document whether valid records are committed all at once or incrementally, and how partial import success is represented.
The system should retain or expose the import error report after completion and allow imported asset records to be traced to the source upload.
Decide whether asset data export requires an Admin role or remains available to all Users, and document any role restriction.
Clarify the trigger, ownership, and activation conditions of 'Provide Download Link' for the FR-18 export workflow.
Document that 'Validate Request' applies to export requests and covers format and selected asset validation.
Define validation rules for export format and selected asset data, and connect them to the export workflow.
Document 'Prepare File' as the operation that generates the downloadable data file for export.
Clarify whether the validation step in FR-19 is represented by 'Validate Request' and define its scope if distinct.
Document whether senior-admin approval is a required condition before permission update in FR-19.
Define the user reference in the permission form and its relationship to the 'User' element if applicable.
Define the scope of the assign management permissions operation within FR-19, including its handoff to validation and staging.
Validate the permission request against required user ID and permission level before staging for senior-admin approval.
Apply permissions only after senior-admin approval; define behavior for rejected or withdrawn requests.
Confirm whether 'Senior Admin' is an alias, role, or subtype of the 'Senior administrators' actor in the replacement workflow.
Clarify whether senior-admin approval is the top-level approval required before admin records are updated.
Confirm whether 'Validate Request' is the validation operation for the replacement form or a separate request type.
The system should determine and record whether the replacement request passed validation before it is staged for top-level approval.
The system should expose a pending-approval state or queue for replacement requests staged for top-level approval.
The system should define which admin records and linked references are updated when a replacement is approved.
The system should record the top-level approver, decision, and approval time for each replacement request.
The system should retain and expose the updated admin record status 'Replaced' for verification or audit.
The system should validate that the asset request form contains a name, type, quantity, and purpose, and reject invalid submissions before staging.
The system should update the stored request status to 'Rejected' when an admin rejects it, mirroring the approval update.
The system should place validated asset requests into a pending state and make them available to an admin for approval or rejection.
The system should identify the Admin actor responsible for approving or rejecting staged asset requests.
The system should allow a User to submit the asset-request form to initiate the request process.
The system should clarify whether asset requests require Senior Admin approval in addition to Admin approval.
The system must identify the recipient user(s) for asset request decision notifications.
The system must record the asset request as approved when the administrator selects the approve decision.
The system must update the asset request status to reflect the approval decision and store the provided reason.
The system must send a notification to affected users containing the asset request decision and reason.
The system must require a reason when an administrator rejects an asset request.
The system should define the expected timing and delivery mechanism for sending event-triggered email notifications.
The system should record per-recipient send log details including status and failure reasons where applicable.
The system should document whether registration-triggered notifications include activation emails as a distinct notification type.
The system should define how recipients are determined for each event type, including the role of the User element.
The system should define the required event detail fields for composing event-specific email notifications.
The system should notify the correct administrative role when user feedback is received and stored.
The system should identify the submitting user as the source of the feedback email when receiving it.
The system should define how unparseable feedback content is handled after receipt.
The system should allow stored feedback to reflect its handling status after admin review.
The system should ensure notified administrators can act on stored feedback, including any defined acknowledgement or escalation.
The system should allow users to query asset change history using one or more of the documented criteria (asset ID, change type, change date) as needed for audit.
The system should define how large asset change history result sets are returned (e.g., pagination or result limit) to keep queries manageable.
The system should document whether asset change events are the source for asset change history queries, so returned history corresponds to recorded changes.
The system should define authorized user roles for viewing asset categories.
The system should compute asset count from current asset records when displaying category details.
The system should define whether administrators have permission to query asset categories.
The system should provide a query operation for asset categories by name or ID, and may support additional criteria if required.
The system should allow users to clear search criteria.
The system should display category details, and may provide export if needed.
Administrators should have a documented entry point to the Edit Asset Category function for modifying category name and description.
Senior Admin should have a documented approval step for staged category edits.

The Edit Asset Category function should accept category name and description changes for staged approval.
The system should update the category only after senior-admin approval is granted.
